blocks.title: Observe
blocks.text: A class describes an object; the array stores references to two Book instances.

blocks.title: Explain
blocks.text: Indexes start at 0. shelf[1] identifies the second reference, then .Title reads its property.

blocks.title: Apply
blocks.text: An array has a fixed length after creation; individual array elements can refer to objects whose properties change.
